{{Quote|Even life-forms without midi-chlorians and cellular structures, such as the fractal urchins of Protogeyser, can touch its energy.|An excerpt from ''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'' by Jedi biologist Bowspritz, discussing the ability of animals to touch the Force|<ref name="TJP" />}}
'''Fractal urchins''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to<ref name="TJP" /> the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]<ref name="Atlas Appendix">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Protogeyser system/Legends|Protogeyser system]]</ref> astronomical object [[Protogeyser]]. Known to [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]] of [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], the species was distinguished by its lack of cellular structures and thus [[Midi-chlorian/Legends|midi-chlorians]],<ref name="TJP" /> symbiotic life-forms that lived inside cells and allowed their host to detect [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> This characteristic earned the fractal urchins a mention in the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|trainee]] [[Book/Legends|guidebook]] ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]'',<ref name="TJP" /> first published as early as the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[990 BBY]]<ref name="TJP-PublishingDate">According to [[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path'']], the book was first published "''a decade or more after the end of the [[New Sith Wars]] in [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]]''." This is taken here to mean the year [[990 BBY]].</ref> and still in use during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] that [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|began]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. Authored by a [[Jedi Researcher|Jedi biologist]], [[Bowspritz]], the "Galactic Bestiary" section of the book described fractal urchins as an example of animals that were connected to the Force despite their lack of midi-chlorians. More detailed information on the species was available in the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]] on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world, [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="TJP" />

==Behind the scenes==
Fractal urchins were mentioned in [[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']], a reference book written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and published in [[2010]].<ref name="TJP" />
